narrative.overview: FausCrew inherits the mobile app's orange-to-berry identity, original roof-F mark and rounded light surfaces. The website extends that established identity with locally bundled Manrope and generous space around concise Turkish copy. This document describes the implemented site, rather than introducing a new brand direction.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper backgrounds and dark berry emphasis.
Clear, rounded typography with compact supporting copy.
Softly elevated app demonstrations and flat surrounding content.
Consistent Lucide line icons and initial-based member avatars.
dos: Do preserve the original roof-F icon and orange-to-berry app identity.
Do use warm light surfaces and clear type hierarchy around the demonstration.
Do keep illustrative app data explicitly identified as examples.
Do provide visible keyboard focus and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't introduce a replacement logo or unrelated visual identity for new sections.
Don't promote miniature phone-label sizes into normal page content.
Don't add invented store availability, product statistics or testimonials.
